description:
**Company Description** 
 Wowsly, established in 2017 under parent company WT Technologies, provides technology solutions tailored to the event industry. The platform is designed to make high\-quality event management tools accessible to events of all scales and to organizations of all sizes. Wowsly serves a wide range of users, including individuals, companies, NGOs, government bodies, educational institutions, and corporate offices. By focusing on usability and scalability, Wowsly aims to transform how events are planned and experienced, helping customers deliver more organized and engaging events.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sales Executive will work on\-site in Ahmedabad in a full\-time capacity, focusing on identifying and pursuing new business opportunities for Wowsly’s event technology platform. Daily responsibilities include prospecting potential clients, conducting product presentations and demos, and managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals. The role involves maintaining regular communication with existing and prospective customers, understanding their event management needs, and recommending suitable solutions. The Sales Executive will also collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding of clients, track sales metrics, prepare reports, and participate in local marketing and networking activities to strengthen Wowsly’s market presence.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in client communication, relationship building, and negotiation, with the ability to handle objections and close sales.
* Experience in lead generation, pipeline management, and business development, preferably in SaaS, technology, or event\-related services.
* Ability to conduct effective product demos and presentations, both in\-person and via digital channels.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, sales reporting, and basic data analysis to monitor performance and forecast revenue.
* Solid understanding of the event industry or interest in learning how event technology supports different types of organizations.
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven approach with strong organizational and time management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; relevant sales experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Proficiency in English and local languages used in Ahmedabad; ability to travel locally for client meetings as needed.

**Company Description** 
 Montdor Interior Pvt Ltd is a leading interior design firm based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, with a strong focus on residential interiors. The company is trusted by more than 500 clients and is known for blending creativity, functionality, and distinctive design in every project. In addition to interior design, Montdor Interior provides turnkey construction services, outdoor furniture solutions, architecture consulting, and tensile structure services. This end\-to\-end capability allows the team to deliver a seamless experience from initial concept through completion, offering professionals the opportunity to work on diverse, integrated design and build projects.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Senior Sales Executive role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Ahmedabad. The role involves identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, nurturing relationships with existing clients, and managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle for interior and turnkey projects. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include meeting prospective clients, understanding their design and construction needs, preparing proposals and quotations, conducting presentations, and negotiating contracts. The Senior Sales Executive will collaborate closely with design, project, and operations teams to ensure accurate scoping, timely execution, and high client satisfaction. The role also includes tracking sales performance, maintaining CRM records, and contributing to sales strategies and market expansion plans.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and deal\-closing skills in B2C or B2B environments.
* Proven ability in client relationship management, lead generation, and pipeline management.
* Basic understanding of interior design, architecture, or construction services to communicate solutions effectively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, presentation skills, and professional customer\-facing demeanor.
* Comfort with CRM tools, MS Office, and reporting of sales metrics and forecasts.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet or exceed sales targets.
* Previous experience in interiors, real estate, construction, or related industries is highly desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
* Willingness to travel locally within Ahmedabad and nearby areas for client visits and site meetings.
